description: There is a genuinely accepted empty-context proof of \(\bot\to\bot\). The defective circular modus-ponens test accepts \(\bot\) after that proof, although the existing first-order calculus cannot derive \(\bot\) from the empty original-language theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.CodingFormalProofs.circular_false_accepted.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) :
  ∃ d,
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.Der S d (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.contextCode S [])
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.impCode Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.botCode
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.botCode) ∧
      Lemmatheca.Entry.CodingFormalProofs.circularMPCheck (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.proofConclusion d)
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.botCode =
          true ∧
        ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives ∅ ⊥
